"body": "**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Stop the Vita app before syncing emoji files**

When the emoji stamp is missing or an image changes, listing it in `DEPENDS` makes CMake run the 4,000-file FTP upload before any `upload_vita` command; `Destroy running apps` therefore runs only after the transfer, and not at all if it fails. If the running app requests an emoji while its PNG is being overwritten, it can cache the failed lookup and keep showing fallback glyphs after a failed transfer. Run the sync after stopping the app; the added skill’s stop-then-upload sequence is otherwise inaccurate.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L60-L60](https://github.com/matemolnar8/vitadeck/blob/d1eab1fd4fcce3dafda1cee8e6ff7f7b24aec32d/AGENTS.md#L60-L60)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
